controls.name: Dual authorisation of payment files
controls.description: Every outbound payment file requires release by a second authorised operator before submission to clearing.

controls.name: Duplicate payment file detection
controls.description: Gateway rejects files whose hash and value date match a file submitted in the last 5 days.

controls.name: Sanctions screening of wire instructions
controls.description: Real-time screening of all outbound wires against consolidated sanctions lists before release.

controls.name: Quarterly user access recertification
controls.description: Department heads attest to the access held by their staff each quarter; unattested access is revoked.

controls.name: Automated leaver access revocation
controls.description: HR termination record triggers same-day deprovisioning of all federated application access.

controls.name: Mandatory MFA on all remote access
controls.description: Phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication enforced for all externally reachable applications.

controls.name: Change advisory board approval
controls.description: All production changes require documented CAB approval, rollback plan and test evidence.

controls.name: Pre-release regression test suite
controls.description: Automated regression pack must pass at 100% before a release is promoted to production.

controls.name: Daily core banking batch reconciliation
controls.description: Overnight batch output reconciled to control totals with breaks escalated before opening.

controls.name: Interest rate change independent review
controls.description: Product rate changes are recalculated independently on a sample before release to production.

controls.name: Manual journal review threshold
controls.description: Journals above GBP 250,000 require review and approval by the Financial Controller.

controls.name: Complaint SLA monitoring
controls.description: Daily exception report of complaints approaching the 8-week regulatory deadline.

controls.name: Records retention schedule enforcement
controls.description: Automated deletion of customer documentation once the statutory retention period expires.

controls.name: Credit policy version control
controls.description: Decision engine policy versions are signed off and pinned; deployment requires policy owner approval.

controls.name: Third-party resilience assessment
controls.description: Annual assessment of critical vendors covering continuity, exit planning and concentration risk.

controls.name: DDoS protection and rate limiting
controls.description: Edge protection with automatic mitigation and rate limiting on public banking channels.

controls.name: Payroll pre-payment verification
controls.description: Variance report comparing the current payroll run to the prior month, reviewed before disbursement.

controls.name: Security awareness and phishing simulation
controls.description: Mandatory annual training with quarterly simulated phishing campaigns and targeted follow-up.

controls.name: Statement production completeness check
controls.description: Account count on the statement run reconciled to the eligible account population before dispatch.

controls.name: Outbound correspondence address validation
controls.description: Address matched to the customer record of truth at print time; mismatches are quarantined.

incidents.title: Statement run omitted 6,200 accounts
incidents.description: The October statement cycle excluded accounts whose product code had been migrated the previous week, so 6,200 customers received no statement. Detected by a customer complaint spike rather than by the production control.
incidents.root_cause: Product code migration was not reflected in the statement eligibility query.

incidents.title: Branch flood damaged physical customer records
incidents.description: A burst pipe above the Leeds branch records room damaged approximately 40 archive boxes of pre-digitisation customer documentation. No customer-facing service was interrupted.
incidents.root_cause: Ageing building plumbing; records room located beneath a wet riser.

incidents.title: Third-party KYC provider outage halted onboarding
incidents.description: The identity verification provider suffered a 6-hour regional outage. New account applications could not be completed and 310 applications were abandoned.
incidents.root_cause: No secondary verification provider configured; single point of dependency.

incidents.title: Suspected internal expense fraud
incidents.description: Routine analytics identified a pattern of duplicated and inflated expense claims by a contractor over 14 months. Referred to HR and Internal Audit; contractor engagement terminated.
incidents.root_cause: Expense approval limits were not enforced for contractor cost codes.

incidents.title: Failed change caused CRM downtime
incidents.description: A CRM integration release deployed without the agreed rollback plan. Case management was unavailable for 4 hours 20 minutes across the contact centre.
incidents.root_cause: CAB approved the change on the basis of incomplete test evidence.

incidents.title: Manual journal error overstated provisions
incidents.description: A manual provision journal was posted with the value in the wrong currency column, overstating provisions by GBP 1.2m in the draft management accounts. Corrected before external reporting.
incidents.root_cause: Journal template lacked currency validation; reviewer checked total only.

incidents.title: Misdirected customer correspondence
incidents.description: Forty-one annual summary letters were despatched to superseded addresses following a bulk address update that did not propagate to the print queue.
incidents.root_cause: Print queue consumed a cached address extract taken before the update.

incidents.title: Internet banking degraded by volumetric attack
incidents.description: A sustained volumetric attack against the public banking portal degraded response times for 95 minutes. Edge mitigation engaged automatically; no data was exposed.
incidents.root_cause: Attack volume exceeded the previously configured rate-limit thresholds.

incidents.title: Loan decision engine applied stale credit policy
incidents.description: For nine days the decision engine served a superseded affordability policy, resulting in 68 applications being assessed against outdated thresholds. All affected cases were re-decisioned.
incidents.root_cause: Policy deployment rolled back automatically but the pinned version was not re-applied.

incidents.title: Data warehouse load failure corrupted regulatory report
incidents.description: A partial overnight load left duplicate rows in the exposures table. The draft regulatory return was produced from the corrupted dataset and required resubmission.
incidents.root_cause: Load job had no idempotency key and no completeness assertion before publish.

incidents.title: Wire to sanctioned counterparty not blocked at first pass
incidents.description: A USD wire matched a sanctions list entry only at the second screening pass, 40 minutes after instruction capture. The payment was stopped before settlement and reported.
incidents.root_cause: Screening list refresh lagged 36 hours behind the published update.

incidents.title: Complaint backlog breached regulatory deadline
incidents.description: Nineteen complaints exceeded the eight-week final response deadline during a period of elevated volumes and staff absence. Affected customers were contacted and compensated.
incidents.root_cause: SLA exception report was produced but not worked during the absence period.

incidents.title: Unauthorised system access retained by leaver
incidents.description: A leaver retained active access to the treasury system for 23 days after their termination date. Access logs confirm no use of the account after departure.
incidents.root_cause: Treasury system is not federated to the IAM platform, so automated revocation did not apply.

incidents.title: Payroll overpayment to 12 employees
incidents.description: A shift-allowance table was uploaded twice, doubling the allowance for 12 employees in the June run. Overpayments were recovered in the following cycle.
incidents.root_cause: Variance report threshold was set above the value of the duplicated allowance.

incidents.title: Vendor data centre power failure
incidents.description: A supplier data centre lost utility power and failed over to generator with a 12-minute gap, interrupting reporting extracts. No customer-facing systems were affected.
incidents.root_cause: Supplier generator transfer switch failed its automatic start sequence.

incidents.title: Card-not-present fraud spike
incidents.description: An enumeration attack drove a three-day spike in card-not-present fraud attempts. 214 transactions were authorised before velocity rules were retuned.
incidents.root_cause: Velocity rules did not account for low-value enumeration patterns.

incidents.title: Incorrect interest applied to 1,840 savings accounts
incidents.description: A rate change was keyed against the wrong product tier, under-paying interest on 1,840 accounts for two months. Redress and interest adjustment are in progress.
incidents.root_cause: Independent recalculation was not performed; the reviewer approved on sight of the change ticket.

incidents.title: Mobile app login failures after release
incidents.description: Release 8.4.0 introduced a token refresh defect causing intermittent login failures for approximately 11% of mobile sessions over 18 hours before rollback.
incidents.root_cause: Regression pack had no coverage for expired-token refresh paths.

incidents.title: KYC documents retained beyond policy period
incidents.description: An audit sample found identity documentation for closed accounts retained up to 3 years beyond the retention schedule because the deletion job silently failed.
incidents.root_cause: Retention job failure was logged but produced no alert or exception report.

incidents.title: Phishing campaign harvested staff credentials
incidents.description: A targeted campaign impersonating the IT service desk captured credentials for 7 staff accounts. MFA blocked access on 6; one legacy account without MFA was accessed for 11 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: A legacy service account was exempted from MFA enforcement and never reviewed.

incidents.title: Core banking outage during month-end close
incidents.description: A storage array firmware fault took the core banking platform offline for 3 hours 10 minutes on the second day of month-end close, delaying the close by a full day.
incidents.root_cause: Firmware level was outside the vendor support matrix; the patch window had been deferred three times.

incidents.title: Duplicate payment file submitted to clearing
incidents.description: A domestic payment file was submitted twice after an operator retried a timed-out upload. Duplicate detection did not fire because the retry produced a new file hash.
incidents.root_cause: Duplicate detection keys on file hash only; a re-generated file defeats the check.

actions.title: Re-key duplicate detection on value date and control totals
actions.description: Change the gateway duplicate check to key on originator, value date and file control totals rather than file hash alone.

actions.title: Add idempotent upload tokens to the payments portal
actions.description: Issue a single-use submission token so an operator retry cannot create a second logical submission.

actions.title: Recall and reconcile duplicated payments
actions.description: Work the clearing recall file and reconcile recovered value against the duplicated batch.

actions.title: Bring storage array firmware into the vendor support matrix
actions.description: Apply the vendor-supported firmware level across both arrays and re-baseline the patch calendar.

actions.title: Introduce a deferral limit for critical patch windows
actions.description: No more than one deferral of a critical infrastructure patch window without CIO sign-off.

actions.title: Freeze infrastructure change during month-end close
actions.description: Add a standing change freeze covering the first three working days of each month for core banking.

actions.title: Remove all MFA enforcement exemptions
actions.description: Enumerate every account exempted from MFA, migrate service accounts to certificate authentication and remove the exemption group.

actions.title: Quarterly review of authentication exemptions
actions.description: Add an exemption register reviewed each quarter alongside access recertification.

actions.title: Run a targeted service-desk impersonation simulation
actions.description: Deliver a phishing simulation modelled on the observed campaign with follow-up training for those who interact.

actions.title: Add alerting to the records retention deletion job
actions.description: Emit a failure alert and a monthly exception report when the retention job does not complete cleanly.

actions.title: Purge documentation held beyond the retention schedule
actions.description: Identify and securely delete the over-retained population, with evidence retained for the regulator.

actions.title: Complete customer redress for savings interest shortfall
actions.description: Recalculate and pay interest owed to the 1,840 affected accounts, including compensatory interest.

actions.title: Mandate independent recalculation of rate changes
actions.description: Require a second preparer to recalculate a sample of accounts on a test environment before any rate change is released.

actions.title: Add post-implementation interest verification report
actions.description: Produce an automated first-accrual comparison after every rate change, reviewed by Finance.

actions.title: Recruit two additional complaint handlers
actions.description: Increase permanent handler capacity to absorb seasonal volume and absence.

actions.title: Escalate the complaint SLA exception report to a named deputy
actions.description: Name a deputy reviewer so the daily exception report is always worked during absence.

actions.title: Federate the treasury system to the IAM platform
actions.description: Bring the treasury system into single sign-on so automated leaver revocation applies.

actions.title: Reconcile non-federated applications to the leaver feed monthly
actions.description: Interim control: monthly reconciliation of remaining non-federated application accounts to HR leavers.

actions.title: Retune card velocity rules for low-value enumeration
actions.description: Add velocity and decline-rate rules covering low-value probing patterns across merchant categories.

actions.title: Pursue scheme chargeback recoveries
actions.description: Lodge chargebacks for eligible authorised fraudulent transactions and track recovery.

actions.title: Extend the regression pack to token refresh paths
actions.description: Add automated coverage for expired, rotated and revoked token refresh scenarios on mobile.

actions.title: Add a canary release stage for the mobile channel
actions.description: Route 2% of sessions to a new release for 60 minutes before full rollout.

actions.title: Increase sanctions list refresh frequency to hourly
actions.description: Move the screening list refresh from daily to hourly with a staleness alert.

actions.title: Add completeness assertion to warehouse publish step
actions.description: Block publication of the exposures dataset unless row counts and checksums match the source extract.

actions.title: Make warehouse load jobs idempotent
actions.description: Introduce load keys so a partial re-run replaces rather than appends.

actions.title: Re-pin credit policy version after automated rollback
actions.description: Ensure the decision engine re-applies the approved policy version on any automated rollback.

actions.title: Re-decision affected loan applications
actions.description: Re-assess the 68 affected applications against the correct policy and contact customers.

actions.title: Raise edge rate-limit thresholds and add attack playbook
actions.description: Retune mitigation thresholds for the public portal and document the response playbook.

actions.title: Source a secondary identity verification provider
actions.description: Contract a fallback KYC provider and implement automatic failover.

actions.title: Enforce approval limits on contractor cost codes
actions.description: Apply the standard expense approval hierarchy to all contractor cost codes.

actions.title: Require test evidence attachment before CAB approval
actions.description: CAB tooling blocks approval unless test evidence and a rollback plan are attached.

actions.title: Add currency validation to the journal template
actions.description: Reject journal uploads where the value column does not match the declared currency.

actions.title: Source addresses for print at despatch time
actions.description: Replace the cached address extract with a live lookup at print time.

actions.title: Lower the payroll variance report threshold
actions.description: Reduce the variance alert threshold so duplicated allowances are surfaced before disbursement.

actions.title: Add statement run completeness reconciliation
actions.description: Reconcile the statement population to eligible accounts before despatch each cycle.

actions.title: Relocate the Leeds branch records store
actions.description: Move archived documentation out of the room beneath the wet riser and accelerate digitisation.

actions.title: Add supplier generator transfer testing to the resilience assessment
actions.description: Require evidence of successful transfer-switch testing in the annual vendor resilience assessment.

Reportable under operational incident rules; notification drafted with Compliance.

Seven accounts confirmed compromised. Six blocked by MFA; one legacy account accessed for 11 minutes.
Forensics found no data exfiltration. Exemption removal is 55% complete.
Raised from audit sample AUD-2026-11. Retention job last succeeded 2023-09.
Over-retained population sized at approximately 4,700 customers. Purge plan agreed with Legal.
Identified during the August accrual review. Two months of under-payment confirmed.
Redress methodology agreed. Provision of GBP 212k booked.
Nineteen breaches confirmed. All customers contacted with a final response and goodwill payment.
Deputy reviewer control implemented. Awaiting recruitment completion before closure.
Velocity rules retuned in production; attack volume collapsed within the hour.
Chargeback recoveries complete at GBP 121k. Incident closed.
Access removed and log review complete. No activity after the termination date.
